meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 把 Python 代码（Flask、Django、FastAPI 等）部署到 Azure 的 App Service（Linux 环境）。它会自动创建和配置资源组、服务计划等，设置启动命令，执行部署，完成后只显示结果，不做额外验证。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等关键词，或要求把 Python 部署到 Azure App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 开始部署，自动命名资源组和计划。

say.text: 把我的 Django 项目部署到 App Service
部署我的 Python 应用到 Azure，应用名 myapp
say.note: 只询问应用名，其余用默认值。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. It creates resource group, plan, and web app with defaults if missing, sets startup command, performs deploy, then stops without further verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', or asks to deploy Python to App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
Deploy my Django project to App Service
Deploy my Python app to Azure, app name myapp
say_en.note: Only app name is asked; the rest use defaults.
